experiments.design: 3000 entities; 4-role relation instances; explicit relation identity versus naive entity pairwise co-occurrence intersection; density sweep, 10000 sampled queries/condition.
experiments.interpretation: Naive pairwise co-occurrence preserved near-complete recall but became highly ambiguous as relation density increased. This does not prove native hyperedges are required: typed relation-instance/incidence lowerings may preserve exact n-ary semantics.

experiments.design: 3000-node, 10-community, 9000-hyperedge activation-diffusion proxy; 10 seeds; compare UNBOUNDED, HARD context gate and ADAPTIVE gated propagation.
experiments.interpretation: Unbounded propagation rapidly occupied the full graph and lost context specificity. Hard gating retained context but removed almost all cross-context diversity. The current adaptive construction remained too close to hard gating, so the diversity-reserve policy is still unresolved rather than validated.

experiments.design: 300000 operations, 24 domains, six alternative contexts, three dependencies/context, 8% hidden active dependency probability.
experiments.interpretation: Static union is safe in this construction but massively overinvalidates. Active-context scope is efficient only when dependency closure is known. Explicit UNKNOWN plus broadening eliminated constructed unsafe accepts at far lower rejection cost than static union.

experiments.design: Local CPython multiprocessing producer/consumer microbenchmark. Pipe copies payload through IPC. Shared-memory arm copies each payload into a preallocated SharedMemory buffer then sends a one-byte readiness signal. Consumer touches first/last byte. Not end-to-end equivalent to a production ABI.
experiments.interpretation: In this local mechanism proxy the shared-memory route won all tested p50s, with advantage increasing with payload. This contradicts any claim that the first failed run showed a 1KiB crossover. It still does not establish universal superiority because synchronization, contention, cache visibility, lifecycle, fault isolation and platform costs were not modeled.
